ogDescription: Building scalable backend systems, web applications, and mobile products.

hero.heading: I build software for real products, real users, and real problems.
hero.description: I design and build scalable backend systems, modern web applications, and mobile experiences with clean architecture, practical interfaces, and a product-first mindset.

projectsPreview.heading: Selected Work
projectsPreview.intro: Products and experiments that connect product thinking with engineering execution, from backend services to mobile and web interfaces.

items.name: CourtRank
items.description: A platform for padel clubs that brings players, clubs, reservations and competitive experiences into one product. The work combines backend architecture, data modeling, admin workflows and a React Native mobile experience designed for real usage.

items.name: PlayZone VIP
items.description: A web experience for an entertainment brand, focused on fast loading, clear navigation, SEO foundations and conversion-oriented pages. The project balances frontend polish with practical performance decisions.

items.name: MVNEX
items.description: A CLI that tries to give Maven a more npm-like experience: more memorable commands, shorter workflows, and less friction in Java projects. It is built in C++ as a systems, performance, and developer tooling exercise.

expertise.heading: What I work with
expertise.intro: A balanced toolkit for designing product flows, implementing reliable services, shipping interfaces and keeping systems maintainable after the first release.

categories.name: Backend
categories.description: I enjoy building APIs, services and data flows that make products dependable. My backend work is usually shaped around clear boundaries, readable code and architecture that can evolve.

categories.name: Frontend
categories.description: I build interfaces that feel direct, responsive and useful. I care about the small details that make a product easier to understand, without losing sight of performance and accessibility.

categories.name: Engineering
categories.description: I like the engineering layer around the product: deployment, collaboration, maintainability, debugging and the habits that keep a codebase healthy over time.

aboutPreview.heading: Software engineer with a product mindset.
aboutPreview.bio: I'm Sebastian, a software engineer passionate about building useful, scalable and well-crafted products. I enjoy solving real problems, learning new technologies and turning ideas into working solutions that people can actually use. My work often sits between backend architecture, product decisions and the interfaces that bring the system to life.

closing.heading: Have a project or opportunity in mind?
closing.description: I'm always open to discussing new ideas, interesting projects or potential collaborations, especially when the work involves product engineering, backend systems, mobile apps or thoughtful web experiences.
